ticks.claim: No zero of zeta lies off the critical line by way of a Lagarias (elementary divisor-sum) counterexample at n <= 1,000,000: the sieve finds none in [1, 1,000,000] (tightest n>=2 at n=12, sigma/(H_n+e^H_n ln H_n) = 0.988636 < 1). Lagarias 2002 — Robin made exception-free — a fourth independent tool narrowing the window, by elimination.
